text:
maya (Product): quick heads-up — I'm drafting a compact launch plan for Console observability MVP: dashboards + tracing hooks + cost breakdown + error analytics. need alignment on acceptance criteria and the minimal signal set. TL;DR: propose 3 dashboards, 2 trace hooks, per-route cost table, error-sample pipeline. cc @todd @irene @liz :eyes:

maya (Product): goal is a lightweight, testable slice we can ship to early enterprise customers (AcmeHealth & FinEdge) for feedback. trying to avoid scope creep — suggest hard cuts if perf or infra cost > 15% increase.

todd (Eng-Platform): curious — what's the expected qps and retention for traces? sampling matters for perf. also, do we plan to use existing trace backfill job or a new stream?

irene (Eng-SRE): +1 on sampling question. SRE needs SLO/alerting hooks before GA. can we define one operational playbook item today?

maya (Product): propose targets: dashboards show 90/95/99 latency heatmaps, error rate by service, cost per route. traces: hook at request.entry and request.invoke (low overhead). sampling: 1% baseline, adjustable by route. retention: 7d for full traces, aggregated metrics 90d.

samir (Eng-Infra): 1% full traces at peak for a few customers might still be heavy. need to quantify tokens and storage. we should include a quick cost budget calc in the plan.

liz (Solutions): from customers: AcmeHealth wants per-customer cost breakdown (multi-tenant) and FinEdge is asking for error sample context (user id + prompt hash). both are high priority for pilot.

maya (Product): noted. proposal: ship minimal per-route cost table (no per-customer calc) for MVP, but make per-customer hooks behind a feature flag for pilot customers. FinEdge-style error context: include as redacted metadata field on sampled traces.

maya (Product): acceptance checklist (draft):
```
- Dashboards: 3 widgets (latency heatmap, error rate by service, cost-per-route table) — owner: todd — perf budget: <15% infra delta
- Tracing hooks: request.entry, request.invoke — owner: samir — sampling 1% default, feature-flag adjustable
- Error analytics: error-sample pipeline capturing stack + redacted user context — owner: liz — retention 7d
- Cost pipeline: ingest per-route meter, compute unit cost, surface per-route table — owner: todd — exclude per-customer for MVP
- SLOs & Alerts: basic latency and error alerts wired to oncall playbook — owner: irene
- Rollout: canary to 3 pilot accounts, fallback to legacy metrics on failure — owner: maya
```

maya (Product): target milestone: pilot-ready in 3 weeks (2026-04-20). if infra cost estimate >20% of current telemetry spend, cut trace retention to 3d and reevaluate.

irene (Eng-SRE): playbook quick add: runbook for alert noise (tier 0/1), rollback steps, and a synthetic test to validate dashboards after deploy. I'll draft and attach.

todd (Eng-Platform): I'll scope widget infra. quick note: prefer pre-aggregated buckets for heatmap to reduce write QPS. also need a migration plan for existing metrics naming.

samir (Eng-Infra): will run a cost estimate by EOD tomorrow — includes storage + ingestion + compute. if estimate looks bad, I'll propose quantization/aggregation first-cut.

liz (Solutions): I'll prep a one-pager for pilot customers explaining what data we capture and the opt-in feature flag for per-customer cost. wants to review privacy redaction with security.

maya (Product): thanks team. ACTIONS:
- samir: infra cost estimate (due 1768250350) :calendar:
- todd: quick widget POC + pre-agg schema (due 1768250450)
- irene: runbook draft + synthetic test (due 1768250400)
- liz: customer one-pager + redaction checklist (due 1768250500)
- maya: finalize acceptance criteria doc and roll-out plan (due 1768250600)

ops-bot: Canary quota set for 'console-observe-mvp' -> 3 pilot accounts (meta).

todd (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup: ack'ing owner items. will ping infra if pre-agg changes required.

samir (Eng-Infra): noted. I'll include a cost break-even table in the estimate.

irene (Eng-SRE): ack. will add an oncall quick play titled "OBS MVP noisy alerts".

liz (Solutions): ack — will loop security on redaction rules.

maya (Product): great. if no objections by EOD I'll lock scope and spin tickets. small ask: keep any new fields minimal — prefer using existing metric names where possible. :white_check_mark:
